notes.notes:
v0.11.0 introduced some bugs that we have addressed with this little patch.

Fixes


 Fixed submarine jumping occasionally when firing
 Fixed enemy ships are displayed with wrong rotation
 Fixed sunk ships are still selectable

notes.title: Update 0.11.0
notes.notes:
It has become somewhat quiet, but we haven't done nothing in the past months! The goal now is to make the game shippable (no pun intended). We'll mainly tackle the following topics:


 Updated UI - getting away from the current "boxy" look
 More toony look in-game for a more consistent feeling
 Customisation options for lobbies (amount of ships, properties of ships etc.)
 Localisation support

With that said, we've been working on another update.

There will be no playtest for now, but we will do another one soon™. We'll keep you posted here as well as on our Discord server.

Features

 Add in-game controller support
 Improve feedback for failed ship placement
 Rebuild crosshair to show ship weapon's cooldown timers
 Overhaul look of finishing explosions for all ships
 Rotate ship weapons towards aiming location
 Make bullets fly an arc


Fixes

 Fix "Start lobby" button is active when ready and alone in lobby
 Fix possible crash when loading avatar

notes.title: Update 0.10.0 - Changelog
notes.notes:
It's playtest time. Again! Another batch of updates made it into this one and we're happy to hear your feedback (I think).

Sunday 7pm CET / 1pm EDT / 10am PDT / 2am JST / 5am AEST

Client

Comeback Mechanic: Our focus this time has been on the duration of a battle. Our solution is the so-called "comeback mechanic". Simply put, if your opponent has an advantage over you by having more ships left, your own ships will have a reduced cooldown timer. 
Or in other words - "Cooldown Modifier for last ship / (Number of ships in fleet - 1)". The cooldown modifier for the last ship is set to 50% for now, meaning that if you have 1 ship left, it will have half the cooldown time as usual.

Either way, you pewpew quicker now when behind.

Features

 implemented comeback mechanism (see above)
 implemented new crosshair with additional information
 the camera will now adjust to your resolution
 your Steam profile picture is now visible in-game
 make ships explode when being sunk
 display controls during battle phase
 auto-dismiss notifications
 show notifications if joining a lobby fails
 hide mouse cursor when aiming at enemy's battlefield section
 updated ship buttons in skirmish scene
 removed custom lobby names


Fixes

 fixed getting stuck in menus when connection to server is lost
 fixed connection status icon showing "connected" status when returning form battle due to "lost connection"
 fixed being stuck in battle screen when connection to server is lost
 fixed handle unreachable IAM server or empty response when logging in
 fixed ships losing their placement occasionally
 fixed setting category buttons disappearing when going to settings screen the second time
 fixed remaining enemy ships being spawned in full damage status
 fixed bullets and torpedos bumping ships out of their position



Server

Features

 greatly increased area of effect distance for all ships
 send area of effect distance with weapon messages
 improved handling for lobby closed event
 improved lobby join failed messages
 removed mapping logic from lobby lifecycle
 improved logging on unhandled exceptions

notes.title: Update 0.9.1 - Changelog
notes.notes:
Just before we launch into the first focus date of this weekend's playtest later today, we have a few quick fixes we want to bring in before we dive into the seas. 

Unfortunately Steam Friends invitations cause the game to crash, so we had to disable them for the time being. They will come back later at some point, though, promise!

Fixes

 Disabled Steam Friends invitations
 Fixed ships being able to visually fire when they're sunk
 Made explosions more visible again


Known Issues

 Game can crash when accepting Steam Friends invite
 Ships are a bit too bright
 Ships catching fire without being destroyed after match ends
 Settings menu loses its tab buttons when visited the second time

notes.title: Update 0.9.0 - Changelog
notes.notes:
Time flies when you're having... fun! ːeaglederpː Another major update made its way onto this platform and we're happy to announce version 0.9.0 with lots of improvements, both behind the scenes and visually. 

To further celebrate this small milestone, we're doing another set of playtests this weekend. We just love finding bugs. So feel free to sign up and participate on the following dates:


 Saturday 6pm CEST / 12pm EDT / 9am PDT / 1am JST / 2am AEST
 Sunday 3pm CEST / 9am EDT / 6am PDT / 11pm JST / 12am AEST


Client

New Features

 Added board game case
 Added harbour model to the main menu screen
 Added implementation of complex water shader
 Added password protected lobbies
 Added filter private lobbies
 Added lobby ownership; only lobby owner can start the lobby
 Added disable join button in lobby list, if lobby is full
 Added filter lobbies by name
 Added Steam friends invitation
 Added wishlist button in main menu
 Added controls showing during placement phase
 Added limit to lobby name length
 Added rotating ships with mouse wheel
 Added news box in main menu
 Added display player ready in placement phase
 Added input keys icons for keyboard and controller
 Added display hit information in enemy section


Fixes

 Fixed countdown of starting lobby does not show up in first second
 Fixed battlefield borders not rendering correctly with new water
 Fixed ship placement goes out-of-sync in special cases
 Fixed resolution options not displaying correctly
 Fixed chimney smoke and fire VFX direction, no matter the ship rotation
 Fixed pixelated social icons in main menu
 Fixed Steam libraries not being pointers (hopefully)
 Fixed wrong display of graphic settings
 Decreased camera exposure compensation



Server

New Features

 Added open telemetry logging and log collection via Loki
 Added lobby monitoring 👀


Fixes

 Fixed preventing lobbies being finished up when they're abandoned already
 Fixed ready up is executed on wrong lobby
 Disabled logging of metrics endpoint
 Disabled logging of health endpoint


Known Issues

 Game can crash when accepting Steam Friends invite
 Ships are a bit too bright
 Ships catching fire without being destroyed after match ends


Thanks, k, bye

notes.title: Update 0.8.1 - Changelog
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you very much for playtesting Marine Battles last week! We’ve been working all week on some fixes. The most annoying bugs should be gone.

If anything occurs to you during a battle, you can now click the battle ID in the bottom right corner to give us some more contextual information. We can then look up what exactly happened with that specific battle, so be sure to include the ID in your feedback!

The latest update 0.8.1 includes various bugfixes on both client and server side.

Fixes

 Fixed countdowns show remaining seconds from server time
 Fixed torpedo trail remains stationary at target position
 Fixed alert sound plays when enemy ship was sunk
 Fixed own ship is de-selected when clicking a sunk ship (both own and opponent's)
 Fixed sunk enemy ships are spawned without weapons
 Fixed escape menu in battle can still be opened during battle debrief
 Fixed last enemy sunk ship doesn't spawn with damage stage/fire effects
 Fixed damage stages are not shown for own ships
 Fixed activate correct default setting
 Fixed when a player finishes placement phase, opponent cannot move ships anymore
 Fixed sunk enemy ships that have been placed vertically, spawn horizontally
 Fixed explosion effect is invisible in shipping build
 Fixed finished lobbies can be reset to waiting state
 Fixed finish up lobbies on forfeit


Features

 battle ID is now included in bottom right corner


Balancing

 doubled AoE damage range for all ships
